question: Which dynasty was founded by Dantidurga in the mid-8th century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtrakuta Dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dantidurga was the founder of the **Rashtrakuta Dynasty**, which rose to prominence in the mid-8th century CE.
 
• The Rashtrakutas initially ruled from **Ellora** and later shifted their capital to **Malkhed**.
 
• Dantidurga defeated the Chalukyas of Badami and established the Rashtrakuta rule in the Deccan region.
 
• The Rashtrakutas were known for their patronage of art and architecture, particularly the famous **Kailasa Temple at Ellora**.
 
• This dynasty played a significant role in medieval Indian history, engaging in military campaigns and cultural exchanges across the Indian subcontinent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ellora Caves:** The Rashtrakuta kings were patrons of art and commissioned the Kailasa Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• **Administration:** The Rashtrakutas followed a decentralized system of governance with provincial rulers managing territories under the central authority.
 
• **Language and Literature:** Sanskrit and Kannada flourished under their rule, with contributions to literature, such as Kavirajamarga.
 
• **Military Campaigns:** The Rashtrakutas expanded their empire through conquests in northern India, defeating the Pratiharas and Palas.
 
• **Trade and Economy:** The dynasty maintained active trade links with both local regions and foreign entities, contributing to economic prosperity.
